calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY — he added to his Amazon position in after-hours trading after the Q3 print; Amazon remains his second-largest position. The ~7% after-hours fall is irrational noise: record 13.9% operating margin, AWS accelerating to 39.3%, and the stock at ~15x operating cash flow, its lowest since 2009.
calls.price_at_call: ~15x trailing operating cash flow vs 25.8x long-run median; conservative DCF implies 20%+ annual share-price compounding over 3 years (20% OCF growth, 17x multiple)
calls.base_case: AWS grows 40% in both 2027 and 2028 (~$392B revenue, ~$145B operating income at 37% margin); Q4 gives a cleaner comparison with advertising back to high-teens growth.
calls.bull_case: AI capex ROI proves out, the multiple re-expands toward 20x+ operating cash flow, and Amazon ends up with two $1T-revenue businesses (e-commerce and AWS).
calls.bear_case: Free-cash-flow burn (-$35B in the quarter, -$62B YTD) funded by debt ($115B raised YTD) stays unsustainable if AI build-out ROI disappoints; AI agents could disrupt the advertising business.

calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY (prior BUY 12 Oct): same closing line as the Meta call — his focus is still going to be on buying more Amazon (and Meta) rather than adding Google, because those businesses offer a lot more value. Amazon's own earnings video is due tomorrow after the close; no Amazon-specific thesis or price is developed in this video.

Conditional buy at $200-$225, first explicit stance (prior tracked was UNCERTAIN): Amazon reports Thursday, AWS grew 37% last quarter and advertising is its highest-margin business, helping an expected ~80% earnings rise to $12.90 on ~15% revenue growth, but capex guided to $220bn has swung free cash flow from +$32bn in 2024 to -$11bn over the last year, which he calls the market's central AI fear. At 20x earnings / 3.5x sales he thinks analysts (average target $330) are overly bullish short term and he would be more comfortable buying at $200-$225.
calls.price_at_call: His buy zone $200-$225; 20x P/E, 3.5x sales; analyst average target $330 as stated
